context: Yumiko and her sister-in-law Naoko meet for lunch and catch up on family things — the kids, Sachiko's health, work.
purpose: sisters-in-law maintenance — adult women navigating family love through shared updates

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ゆみこちゃん、お久しぶり！
lines.style: Aunt bright warm reunion, the familial -chan held with real affection, soft real pleasure threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: なおこさん！本当に。元気だった？
lines.en: Naoko-san! Truly. Have you been well?
lines.style: Maternal warm reunion brightness, the genuine pleasure audible, soft real reciprocal warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 元気元気。ゆみこちゃんは？子供たち大きくなったでしょ。
lines.en: I'm good, I'm good. And you? The kids have grown, right?
lines.style: Aunt warm bouncing follow-up, the genuine curiosity about family audible, soft real interest threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ひなはもう小学生。早いよね、本当に。
lines.en: Hina's already in elementary. Time flies, really.
lines.style: Maternal warm time-reflection, the wonder at growth audible, soft real maternal warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 子供育てるの、大変じゃない？
lines.style: Aunt warm sympathetic check-in, the real care behind the question, soft genuine interest threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 大変だけど、可愛いから。
lines.en: It is, but they're cute, so.
lines.style: Maternal warm honest balance, the truth held in the trailing-off cadence, soft real maternal love throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Aunt warm careful pivot to family health, the real concern audible, soft genuine inquiry threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 腰がちょっとね。でも元気よ、おしゃべりは。
lines.en: Her back, a little. But she's lively — chatty as ever.
lines.style: Maternal warm honest reporting with humor, the affectionate observation audible, soft real love throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: それなら良かった。今度、私も寄るね。
lines.en: That's a relief. I'll come by sometime soon too.
lines.style: Aunt warm closing commitment, the genuine intent audible, soft real family-care threading throughout delivery.
